svg.text: 4WD chassis · L298N · Arduino UNO/Nano · ESP32-CAM · HC-SR04 (rear) · buzzer + rear LEDs · 2 headlights · 2×18650 (no buck converter: the UNO makes the 5 V)
• Battery 7.4 V → switch → L298N +12V. A 2nd wire in the same +12V terminal → UNO VIN.
• The UNO regulator makes the 5 V: UNO 5V pin → 5 V bus (ESP32-CAM, HC-SR04, buzzer, LEDs).
• 2200 µF 16 V capacitor right at the ESP32-CAM 5V/GND pins (+ leg to 5V).
• L298N: keep the 5V-EN jumper ON, remove ENA/ENB jumpers, leave its +5V pin unused.
• Do not add a servo to this 5 V bus (the UNO regulator is too small for it).
• Wires crossing with a small hop are NOT connected. A black dot = connected.
• ALL grounds must be common. Never feed 7.4 V into the ESP32-CAM or UNO 5V pin.
